android_permissions.name: android.permission.CAMERA
android_permissions.description: Required to be able to access the camera device.
android_permissions.impact: Required for apps that take photos or videos. Google Play requires justification if used as a primary feature.
android_permissions.use_case: Taking profile pictures, scanning QR codes.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to access precise location.
android_permissions.impact: High scrutiny on Play Store. Requires prominent disclosure and clear user benefit.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to access approximate location.
android_permissions.impact: Less sensitive than fine location but still requires user consent.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to access extra location provider commands.
android_permissions.impact: Minimal impact, used for specialized location features.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_MOCK_LOCATION
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to create mock location providers for testing.
android_permissions.impact: Restricted to development/debug use. Can be used for location spoofing.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to connect to paired bluetooth devices.
android_permissions.impact: Standard Bluetooth permission for older Android versions.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to discover and pair bluetooth devices.
android_permissions.impact: Standard Bluetooth management for older Android versions.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to pair bluetooth devices without user interaction.
android_permissions.impact: Restricted to system apps or apps signed with the same certificate.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to change network connectivity state.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to enter Wi-Fi Multicast mode.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, but increases battery consumption.
android_permissions.use_case: Discovering devices on local network via multicast.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to change Wi-Fi connectivity state.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.DISABLE_KEYGUARD
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to disable the keyguard if it is not secure.
android_permissions.impact: Can affect device security if misused.
android_permissions.use_case: Showing incoming call screens over lock screen.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.EXPAND_STATUS_BAR
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to expand or collapse the status bar.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.GET_PACKAGE_SIZE
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to find out the space used by any package.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.INSTALL_SHORTCUT
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to install a shortcut in Launcher.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to call ActivityManager.killBackgroundProcesses.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, but can disrupt other apps.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
android_permissions.description: Allows an application a broad access to external storage in scoped storage.
android_permissions.impact: Highly restricted. Requires strong justification for Play Store approval.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to modify global audio settings.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
android_permissions.description: Allows query of any normal app on the device, regardless of manifest declarations.
android_permissions.impact: Highly restricted on Play Store. Requires core feature justification.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS
android_permissions.description: Allows read access to the device's phone number(s).
android_permissions.impact: Sensitive personal data. Restricted on Play Store.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to receive the ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED that is broadcast after the system finishes booting.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission. Can impact boot time if many apps use it.
android_permissions.use_case: Starting background services or alarms on boot.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_MMS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to monitor incoming MMS messages.
android_permissions.impact: Highly sensitive privacy data.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to receive SMS messages.
android_permissions.impact: Highly sensitive. Used for auto-filling OTPs or SMS apps.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to monitor incoming WAP push messages.
android_permissions.impact: Legacy sensitive permission.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.REORDER_TASKS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to change the Z-order of tasks.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_COMPANION_RUN_IN_BACKGROUND
android_permissions.description: Allows a companion app to run in the background.
android_permissions.impact: Allows persistent connection for companion devices.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_COMPANION_USE_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND
android_permissions.description: Allows a companion app to use data in the background.
android_permissions.impact: Allows background data sync for companion devices.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to request deleting packages.
android_permissions.impact: Requires user confirmation before deletion.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
android_permissions.description: Permission an application must hold in order to use Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS.
android_permissions.impact: Highly discouraged by Google. Impacts battery life significantly.
android_permissions.use_case: Critical background apps like messengers or navigation.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.SET_ALARM
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to broadcast an Intent to set an alarm for the user.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.SET_WALLPAPER
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to set the wallpaper.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.SET_WALLPAPER_HINTS
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to set the wallpaper hints.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT
android_permissions.description: Required for apps to use full-screen intents.
android_permissions.impact: Can be intrusive, used for high-priority notifications.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to read from external storage.
android_permissions.impact: Legacy permission. Android 13+ uses scoped storage permissions instead.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to write to external storage.
android_permissions.impact: Legacy permission. Android 13+ uses scoped storage permissions instead.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to open network sockets.
android_permissions.impact: Standard permission, granted automatically by Android.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to record audio.
android_permissions.impact: Highly sensitive. Requires clear justification and user consent.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to read the user's contacts data.
android_permissions.impact: Personal data access. Play Store requires clear explanation of why this is needed.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to access location in the background.
android_permissions.impact: Extremely high scrutiny. Requires specific user opt-in and strong justification for background use.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to access any geographic locations persisted in the user's shared collection.
android_permissions.impact: Required for reading location metadata from photos/videos.
android_permissions.use_case: Photo mapping, displaying where a photo was taken.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to access information about networks.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.
android_permissions.use_case: Checking for internet connectivity before making requests.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to access information about Wi-Fi networks.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to recognize physical activity.
android_permissions.impact: Requires user consent. Used for fitness tracking.
android_permissions.use_case: Step counting, detecting if user is walking or driving.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to discover and pair bluetooth devices.
android_permissions.impact: Requires location permission on older Android versions. High sensitivity due to tracking potential.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to connect to paired bluetooth devices.
android_permissions.impact: Required to interact with Bluetooth devices on Android 12+.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.BODY_SENSORS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to access data from sensors that the user uses to measure what is happening inside their body, such as heart rate.
android_permissions.impact: Highly personal health data. Requires explicit user consent.
android_permissions.use_case: Heart rate monitoring in fitness apps.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.CALL_PHONE
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to initiate a phone call without going through the Dialer user interface.
android_permissions.impact: Can lead to unexpected charges. Highly sensitive.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CALENDAR
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to read the user's calendar data.
android_permissions.impact: Personal schedule access. Requires user consent.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to write the user's calendar data.
android_permissions.impact: Modifying personal schedule. Requires user consent.
android_permissions.use_case: Adding reminders or events to the calendar.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to read the user's call log.
android_permissions.impact: Privacy sensitive. Play Store restricts this to core dialer/SMS apps.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE
android_permissions.description: Allows read only access to phone state, including device ID and network info.
android_permissions.impact: Used for device identification. Highly regulated by Google Play.
android_permissions.use_case: Identifying unique users, checking network type.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_SMS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to read SMS messages.
android_permissions.impact: Extremely sensitive. Restricted to core SMS apps on Play Store.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.SEND_SMS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to send SMS messages.
android_permissions.impact: Can lead to charges. Highly sensitive and restricted.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to post notifications.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 13+. Controls app interruptions.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to use device supported biometric modalities.
android_permissions.impact: Standard for security features. User must still authenticate.
android_permissions.use_case: Fingerprint or Face unlock for app features.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.VIBRATE
android_permissions.description: Allows access to the vibrator.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, granted automatically.
android_permissions.use_case: Haptic feedback for buttons or notifications.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
android_permissions.description: Allows using PowerManager WakeLocks to keep processor from sleeping.
android_permissions.impact: Normal permission, but can impact battery life if misused.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE
android_permissions.description: Required to be able to advertise to nearby Bluetooth devices.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 12+ to make the device discoverable via Bluetooth.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to read image files from shared storage.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 13+ instead of READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE for images.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to read video files from shared storage.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 13+ instead of READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE for videos.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to read audio files from shared storage.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 13+ instead of READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE for audio.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to read image or video files that the user has selected.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 14+ for partial media access.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
android_permissions.description: Allows apps to use exact alarm APIs.
android_permissions.impact: Impacts battery life. Google Play restricts its use for non-core features.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM
android_permissions.description: Allows apps to use exact alarms without user permission.
android_permissions.impact: Restricted to specific app categories (alarms, timers, calendars).

android_permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to use foreground services.
android_permissions.impact: Required for long-running tasks visible to the user.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to use the camera from a foreground service.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 14+ for foreground camera access.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to use the microphone from a foreground service.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 14+ for foreground microphone access.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to access location from a foreground service.
android_permissions.impact: Required for Android 14+ for foreground location access.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.NFC
android_permissions.description: Allows applications to perform I/O operations over NFC.
android_permissions.impact: Required for NFC communication.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS
android_permissions.description: Allows access to the list of accounts in the Accounts Service.
android_permissions.impact: Can be used to identify the user's email accounts.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
android_permissions.description: Allows an app to create windows shown on top of all other apps.
android_permissions.impact: Highly intrusive. Can be used for overlays and phishing.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to read or write the system settings.
android_permissions.impact: Can change device behavior significantly.

android_permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
android_permissions.description: Allows an application to request installing packages.
android_permissions.impact: Required for apps that install other apps (e.g., app stores).

ios_permissions.name: NSCameraUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the camera to take photos and videos.
ios_permissions.impact: App Store rejection if usage description is vague or missing.

ios_permissions.name: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access location while the app is in use.
ios_permissions.impact: Crucial for App Store approval. Description must clearly explain the benefit.

ios_permissions.name: NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access location information while running in the background.
ios_permissions.impact: High scrutiny. Requires strong justification for background access.

ios_permissions.name: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the microphone to record audio.
ios_permissions.impact: Sensitive permission. Requires clear purpose string.

ios_permissions.name: NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's photo library.
ios_permissions.impact: Required for picking photos. Description must be clear.

ios_permissions.name: NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Add photos to the user's photo library.
ios_permissions.impact: Write-only access, less sensitive than full library access.

ios_permissions.name: NSContactsUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's contacts.
ios_permissions.impact: Personal data. Usage description must explain how contacts are used.

ios_permissions.name: NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Use Bluetooth even when the app is in the background.
ios_permissions.impact: Highly sensitive. Requires strong justification for background use.

ios_permissions.name: NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access Bluetooth peripherals.
ios_permissions.impact: Required for interacting with Bluetooth accessories (Legacy).

ios_permissions.name: NSFaceIDUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Use Face ID for authentication.
ios_permissions.impact: Security feature. Description must mention authentication purpose.

ios_permissions.name: NSCalendarsUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's calendar.
ios_permissions.impact: Personal schedule data. Description must explain purpose.

ios_permissions.name: NSRemindersUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's reminders.
ios_permissions.impact: Personal task data access.

ios_permissions.name: NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Send user data to Apple's speech recognition servers.
ios_permissions.impact: Voice data is processed by Apple. User must be informed.

ios_permissions.name: NSMotionUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access device motion and orientation data.
ios_permissions.impact: Used for fitness or movement tracking.

ios_permissions.name: NSAppleMusicUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's media library (Apple Music).
ios_permissions.impact: Personal media library access.

ios_permissions.name: NSUserTrackingUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Track the user across other apps and websites.
ios_permissions.impact: Crucial for advertising and tracking. High user rejection rate.

ios_permissions.name: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Discover and communicate with devices on the local network.
ios_permissions.impact: Security related. Used for finding local hardware.

ios_permissions.name: NSHealthShareUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Read data from the Health app.
ios_permissions.impact: Extremely personal health data. Requires clear justification.

ios_permissions.name: NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Write data to the Health app.
ios_permissions.impact: Modifying health data. Requires clear justification.

ios_permissions.name: NSHomeKitUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access HomeKit configuration data.
ios_permissions.impact: Smart home security access.

ios_permissions.name: NSMediaLibraryUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's media library.
ios_permissions.impact: Personal media access.

ios_permissions.name: NSNFCReaderUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access NFC hardware to scan tags.
ios_permissions.impact: Required for reading NFC tags. Requires entitlement.

ios_permissions.name: NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Add photos to the user's photo library.
ios_permissions.impact: Write-only access to the photo library. Less intrusive than full access.
ios_permissions.use_case: Saving images or videos captured in the app.

ios_permissions.name: NSSiriUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Send user data to Siri to process requests.
ios_permissions.impact: Required for apps that integrate with SiriKit.

ios_permissions.name: NSFocusStatusUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's focus status (Do Not Disturb).
ios_permissions.impact: Allows app to know if notifications are silenced.

ios_permissions.name: NSNearbyInteractionUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access nearby interaction data using Ultra Wideband.
ios_permissions.impact: High-precision distance measurement between devices.
ios_permissions.use_case: Finding nearby friends or items with high accuracy.

ios_permissions.name: NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Read and write access to the user's calendar data.
ios_permissions.impact: Full access to calendar events. Required for iOS 17+.
ios_permissions.use_case: Creating and managing calendar events with full control.

ios_permissions.name: NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Read and write access to the user's reminders data.
ios_permissions.impact: Full access to reminders. Required for iOS 17+.
ios_permissions.use_case: Creating and managing reminders with full control.

ios_permissions.name: NSMainCameraUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the device's main camera (specifically for visionOS).
ios_permissions.impact: Required for camera access on visionOS.
ios_permissions.use_case: Capturing photos or videos in spatial computing.

ios_permissions.name: NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's Desktop folder.
ios_permissions.impact: Allows reading/writing files on the Desktop.
ios_permissions.use_case: Saving or opening files from the Desktop.

ios_permissions.name: NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's Documents folder.
ios_permissions.impact: Allows reading/writing files in the Documents folder.

ios_permissions.name: NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's Downloads folder.
ios_permissions.impact: Allows reading/writing files in the Downloads folder.

ios_permissions.name: NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access files on a network volume.
ios_permissions.impact: Allows interaction with files on network-attached storage.
ios_permissions.use_case: Opening files stored on network drives.

ios_permissions.name: NSFileProviderDomainUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access files managed by a file provider.
ios_permissions.impact: Allows access to cloud storage or other file provider domains.

ios_permissions.name: NSFallDetectionUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access fall detection event data.
ios_permissions.impact: Access to sensitive health/safety data.
ios_permissions.use_case: Detecting and responding to fall events (watchOS).

ios_permissions.name: NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Write-only access to the user's calendar data.
ios_permissions.impact: Allows adding events without reading existing ones. Required for iOS 17+.
ios_permissions.use_case: Adding new appointments to the calendar.

ios_permissions.name: NSLocationDefaultAccuracyReduction
ios_permissions.description: Request reduced location accuracy by default.
ios_permissions.impact: User can still grant full accuracy. Used for privacy-conscious apps.

ios_permissions.name: NSVideoSubscriberAccountUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access the user's TV provider account.
ios_permissions.impact: Personal subscription data access.
ios_permissions.use_case: Streaming content based on provider subscription.

ios_permissions.name: NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access files on a removable volume.
ios_permissions.impact: Allows reading/writing files on external drives/SD cards.

ios_permissions.name: NSWorldSensingUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access world-sensing data for spatial computing.
ios_permissions.impact: Required for visionOS to map the surroundings.
ios_permissions.use_case: Placing virtual objects in the real world.

ios_permissions.name: NSHandsTrackingUsageDescription
ios_permissions.description: Access hand-tracking data for spatial computing.
ios_permissions.impact: Required for visionOS to track hand movements.
ios_permissions.use_case: Interacting with virtual objects using hands.
